test_title: PYST 26: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word to fill in the blank.**

The flow of the river is very __rapid__ now. Let's go in when it's a little ________.
solution: The correct answer is '**slow**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the underlined word '**rapid**' is '**slow**'. • **Rapid**: happening very quickly or moving with great speed. [द्रुत (गति से होने वाला) या द्रुतगामी] • *Example: She made **rapid** progress and was soon the best in the class.* • **Slow**: moving, doing something or happening without much speed; not fast. (धीमी गति से चलते, करते या घटित होते हुए, धीमा या धीमे; वेग से नहीं, मंद) • *Example: Progress was **slower** than expected.* **Correct Answer:__** *slow.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **fast**: able to move or act at great speed. (तेज़, तीव्रगामी) • **quick**: done with speed; taking or lasting a short time. (फुरती से किया गया; थोड़ा समय लेने या रहने वाला) • **delayed**: to make somebody/something slow or late. (किसी को देर करवा देना) 46:Tac9, The correct answer is '**Propelled**'.
